description: Use this when the person has chosen a practice and time and wants to book. Books the non-binding first consultation with a doctor with the person's own name, e-mail and phone number and their agreement to AMITA's privacy policy; AMITA e-mails the confirmation. Cannot change or cancel an appointment.

phone.description: Phone number for the practice team, ideally mobile.

privacyPolicyAccepted.description: Whether the person agreed to AMITA's privacy policy (https://abnehmen-mit-arzt.de/privacy/).

slotIso.description: Start of a free consultation slot of this practice (ISO 8601).

name: book_consultation
title: Book first consultation
